description: Defines classes and methods for SPDY protocol framing, including serialization of various frame types, header compression, and frame iteration within the quiche/spdy library.

classes.name: SpdyFrameSequence
classes.description: Abstract interface for a sequence of SPDY frames, with methods for serialization and iteration.

classes.name: SpdyFramer
classes.description: Main class responsible for serializing SPDY frames, managing header compression, and frame iteration.

classes.name: SpdyFrameIterator
classes.description: Nested class within SpdyFramer for iterating over frames generated from a SpdyFrameIR.

classes.name: SpdyHeaderFrameIterator
classes.description: Nested class for iterating over header frames with large header blocks.

classes.name: SpdyPushPromiseFrameIterator
classes.description: Nested class for iterating over push promise frames with large header blocks.

classes.name: SpdyControlFrameIterator
classes.description: Nested class for converting a single SpdyFrameIR into a SPDY frame sequence.

methods.name: CreateIterator
methods.description: Creates a frame sequence iterator for a given frame IR.

methods.name: GetSerializedFlags
methods.description: Retrieves serialized flags for a given frame.

methods.name: SerializeDataFrameHeaderWithPaddingLengthField
methods.description: Serializes data frame header with optional padding length fields.

methods.name: compression_enabled
methods.description: Checks if header compression is enabled.

methods.name: SetHpackIndexingPolicy
methods.description: Sets the HPACK encoder's indexing policy.

methods.name: UpdateHeaderEncoderTableSize
methods.description: Updates the maximum size of the header encoder table.

methods.name: header_encoder_table_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the header encoder table.
